playerMovement.name: Player Movement
playerMovement.hint: Allows Player Movement to trigger a Level Change.

skipDialog.name: Skip Confirmation Dialog
skipDialog.hint: Automatically performs the Level Change without confirmation. If there are multiple viable levels at the destination, the Confirmation Dialog appears regardless of this setting.

viewLevel.name: View New Level
viewLevel.hint: Automatically switch to the new level on a Level Change. Might screw with the currently selected tokens.

defaultMode.name: Default Mode
defaultMode.hint: Levels with the Destination or Origin mode can only be reached or left (not both) via Elevation Level Change.

collections.label: Collections
collections.hint: Elevation Level Changes are only possible between Levels that share at least one collection. Separate multiple collections with semicolons. An empty selection applies inclusion to all collections.

mode.label: Mode
mode.hint: Levels with the Destination or Origin mode can only be reached or left (not both) via Elevation Level Change.
